_about: Public-domain Abiel Abbot Livermore (1811-1892), Unitarian minister and president of Meadville Theological School, for the Word Hoard: his commentaries on the Four Gospels, Acts, Romans, and Hebrews to Revelation, Lectures to Young Men, The War with Mexico Reviewed, Discourses, and occasional sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 96 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

livermore-four-gospels-1: The Four Gospels: With a Commentary (J. Monroe, 1841)
livermore-four-gospels-2: The four Gospels: with a commentary, Volume 2 (James Munroe and Co., 1842, 1842)
livermore-acts: The Acts of the Apostles : with a commentary (Boston : J. Munroe, 1844)
livermore-young-men: Lectures to young men on their moral dangers and duties (Boston, J. Munroe and company, 1847)
livermore-faith-once-delivered: The faith once delivered to the saints : a discourse delivered at the dedication of the Unitarian meeting-house in Windsor, Vt., Wednesday, December 9, 1846 (Boston : W. Crosby and H.P. Nichols, 1847)
livermore-ancient-honorable: The ancient and honorable man. A discourse preached on the occasion of the death of Hon. John Quincy Adams, to the Unitarian church and congregation, Keene, N.H., on Sabbath afternoon, March 5, 1848 (Keene, Printed by J.W. Prentiss & co., 1848)
livermore-war-with-mexico: The war with Mexico reviewed (Boston, American Peace Society, 1850)
livermore-romans: The Epistle of Paul to the Romans : with a commentary and rev. translation and introductory essays (Boston : Crosby, Nichols, 1854)
livermore-hebrews: The Epistle to the Hebrews: The Epistles of James, Peter, John and Jude, and (Lockwood, Brooks, 1881)

_excluded.livermore-wilton: History of Wilton (written with Sewall Putnam; local history)
